browser.custom_url_hint: Connect any remote MCP server by URL.
browser.custom_package_hint: Install a pinned npm or PyPI MCP server on this server.

callback.copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the URL and copy it manually

context7.description: Get up-to-date library docs and examples.
context7.note: Context7 docs also list the Authorization: Bearer form. This preset uses the verified Context7-API-Key header.

setup.create_key: Create an API key in the Context7 dashboard.
setup.enter_key: In Tofi, enter the key in the Context7-API-Key header.

github.note: The official remote server is hosted by GitHub. Availability and toolsets may depend on your account or Copilot eligibility.

setup.check_scope: Before connecting, review the GitHub MCP toolsets and repository permissions.
setup.prepare_pat: Prepare a fine-grained PAT with the narrowest permissions and enter it in Tofi as a Bearer token.

github_readonly.description: Read repositories, issues and pull requests.
github_readonly.name: GitHub (read-only)
github_readonly.note: Read-only endpoint hosted by GitHub. Tofi's tool approvals and allow/block rules still apply. Source and settings are checked but not yet tested with a real account.

setup.create_pat: Create a fine-grained PAT with read access to only the repositories you need.
setup.enter_token: Enter the PAT in the private token field below. Don't paste it into chat or the headers JSON.
setup.verify: After adding, check the connection and available tools. Account and organization policies still apply.

google_calendar.note: This preset only reads events and checks free/busy. Enable calendar-json.googleapis.com and calendarmcp.googleapis.com.

google_docs.note: Google Docs MCP is in Developer Preview. Enable docs.googleapis.com and docsmcp.googleapis.com.

google_drive.description: Find and organize files in the cloud.
google_drive.note: Google Drive MCP is in Developer Preview. Enable drive.googleapis.com and drivemcp.googleapis.com.

google_gmail.description: Find emails, read them and write drafts.
google_gmail.note: Google Workspace Developer Preview. Enable gmail.googleapis.com and gmailmcp.googleapis.com. Some tools may require gmail.modify or mail.google.com.

google_setup.client_credentials: Enter the Client ID and Secret below, then finish Google authorization after adding.
google_setup.consent_screen: Set up the OAuth consent screen and test users, then create a Web application client and register the redirect URL.
google_setup.agentic_client: When creating the client, check “Use this client for an AI-powered agent”. Workspace MCP rejects other clients from 2026-11-11, and the setting can't be changed on an existing client after 2026-11-12: create a new client instead.
google_setup.enable_apis: In your Google Cloud project, enable the product API and its MCP service.
google_setup.preview_access: Enrol the Cloud project in the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program (developers.google.com/workspace/preview); without it every tool call is refused even though sign-in works.

google_sheets.description: Read data and edit sheets and formulas.
google_sheets.note: Google Sheets MCP is in Developer Preview. Enable sheets.googleapis.com and sheetsmcp.googleapis.com.

google_slides.note: Google Slides MCP is in Developer Preview. Enable slides.googleapis.com and slidesmcp.googleapis.com.

linear.note: Linear's main transport is Streamable HTTP. /mcp/readonly offers read tools only; /sse is a deprecated compatibility path.

setup.check_scope: Before connecting, review team and workspace permissions.
setup.prepare_key: Prepare a Linear API key or Bearer token. If you don't need write access, use the read-only endpoint.

linear_readonly.name: Linear (read-only)
linear_readonly.note: Linear documents this endpoint as read-only tools. Tofi's tool approvals and allow/block rules still apply. Settings are checked but not yet tested with a real account.

setup.create_key: Create a Linear API key with Read permission only, scoped to the teams you need.
setup.enter_token: Enter the key in the private token field below.
setup.verify: After adding, confirm the granted scope and the tool connection.

microsoft_learn.description: Search official technical docs and code samples.

setup.no_account: No account or key needed. The public docs are available as soon as you add it.

notion.description: Find and organize your knowledge base.
notion.note: Notion now focuses on its hosted remote MCP. Enterprise admins can restrict which AI apps can connect.

setup.auto_client: Tofi requests an OAuth client from the service, so you don't need to enter a Client ID.
setup.check_access: Make sure the connected identity has the page access you expect.
setup.choose_workspace: After adding, click Connect and choose the Notion workspace to link.

robinhood.description: Quotes and positions; trades only in your Agentic account.
robinhood.note: Robinhood’s official remote MCP. It can only trade in your Agentic account, and Tofi still asks before acting.

setup.auto_client: Tofi requests an OAuth client from Robinhood, so you don’t need to enter a Client ID.
setup.sign_in: After adding, click Connect and sign in to Robinhood.
setup.agentic_account: Trades are limited to your Agentic account; your other accounts stay out of reach.

error.auth_timeout: Authorization still isn't complete. Try again.
error.discovery_failed: Couldn't load tools. Check the server URL and credentials, then try again.
error.endpoint_changed_headers: The server URL changed. Re-enter or remove the saved header credentials before saving.
error.endpoint_changed_oauth: The server URL changed. Fill in the OAuth settings for the new URL before saving.
error.metadata_changed_secret: The authorization metadata URL changed. Re-enter or clear the saved Client Secret before saving.
error.needs_bot: Create a Bot first to authorize on the shared computer.
error.oauth_discovery_failed: Couldn't read authorization details or register a client. Check the server URL and try again.
error.oauth_start_failed: Couldn't start authorization. Check the server URL and try again.
error.offline: Can't reach the server. Try again.
error.redirect_needs_https: Authorization needs an HTTPS address or a localhost tunnel to Tofi. A private-network HTTP address can't receive the redirect.

form.client_id_optional: OAuth Client ID (leave blank to register automatically)
form.custom_description: Connects to the workspace; Bots discover its tools as needed.
form.headers_invalid: Headers must be a JSON object of names and text values
form.headers_note: Dots or an empty value keep the saved credential; delete the field to remove it. If you change the server URL, re-enter or remove credentials.
form.name: Service ID
form.name_invalid: Service ID must be 1–64 letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens
form.token_keep: Leave blank to keep the saved token
form.token_paste: Paste the token from the service

google.project_hint: In Google Cloud, choose the same project as the OAuth client. While the app is in testing, add your account as a test user under Audience.
google.preview_hint: Enrol the Cloud project in the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program (developers.google.com/workspace/preview); without it every tool call is refused even though sign-in works.
google.agentic_hint: Check “Use this client for an AI-powered agent” (Google Auth Platform → Clients). From 2026-11-11 Workspace MCP rejects clients without it; from 2026-11-12 it is permanent, so an unmarked client must be replaced.
google.redirect_hint: In Google Auth Platform → Clients, open your Web application and add each URL you'll use under Authorized redirect URIs (not JavaScript origins). Both entry points can share these credentials. Address, port and path must match exactly. The shared computer's dynamic HTTP redirect can't use this fixed setup; use HTTPS or the app instead.

workspace.title: Advanced: Google Workspace MCP (Developer Preview)
workspace.deadline: From 2026-11-11 Workspace MCP rejects OAuth clients that are not marked “Use this client for an AI-powered agent”. From 2026-11-12 an existing client cannot be changed: create a new one.
workspace.deadline_past: Workspace MCP now rejects OAuth clients that are not marked “Use this client for an AI-powered agent”, and an existing client cannot be changed: create a new one.

discord.reason: Not a curated connector. You can install a community Discord server yourself under Add connection › Custom › Local package; guide in integrations/discord/discord-add-it-yourself.md.

notion_token.description: Legacy local MCP server, no longer maintained.
notion_token.name: Notion token server (legacy)
notion_token.reason: The provider no longer maintains or supports this local server. It's listed for reference only and isn't in the first wave of support. To connect Notion, use the OAuth connection above.

slack.description: Remote MCP server provided by Slack.
slack.reason: Requires registering a Slack app and user authorization. A Bot token doesn't work for this.

yahoo_finance.reason: No installable compatible version verified yet. The community server needs no token.

custom.env: Environment variables (values are saved as private files and never shown again)
custom.intro: Specify a pinned version and executable. The install command runs on this server, and the plugin runs with this server’s permissions. A community package is code you chose to trust: it sees the variables you give it, and its tools ask for approval until you mark them read-only.
custom.integrity: Package digest (optional, sha512-…; the install fails if the registry serves anything else)

gog.intro: Read your own Gmail with a Google account you authorize. Choose read-only, or allow reading and sending; each email still needs your approval before it’s sent.

google.client_setup: In Google Cloud, create a Web application OAuth client, add the address below under “Authorized redirect URIs”, then upload the downloaded JSON.
google.disconnected: Google authorization removed from the Runner.
google.finish_in_google: Finish authorizing on the Google page. The status updates when you return to Tofi.
google.granted_read_send: Read and send authorized. Each email still needs confirmation before sending.
google.granted_readonly: Read access only. To send, disconnect and choose read and send again.
google.invalid_json: Upload a valid Google OAuth client JSON.
google.needs_https: Open this page from Tofi's configured public HTTPS address.
google.scope_read_send: Read and send: I confirm every email
google.services_note: Read-only tools for each service you pick. Adding a service keeps what you already authorized.
google.scope_readonly_note: Bots can read mail, events and files. Nothing is sent or changed.
google.scope_read_send_note: Gmail only. Every email a Bot wants to send waits for your confirmation.

mcp.empty_body: Bots can read and act in the services you connect.

oauth.help_body: The sign-in method follows how you opened Tofi and works for Google, Notion and other OAuth services. A client you configure yourself needs the full redirect URL below registered in the service's console; services with automatic registration, like Notion, are handled by Tofi.

error.generic: That address could not be verified. Check it and paste it again, or start over.

paste.label: Redirected address
paste.lead: {{title}} redirects only to 127.0.0.1. Approve access in its sign-in page, then paste the address it lands on.
paste.step_copy: After you approve, the browser shows a page that does not load. That is expected. Copy the full address from the address bar.
paste.title: Sign in to {{title}}

route.desktop: Sign in with your system browser; you'll come back to this app when done. The shared computer isn't used.
route.desktop_outdated: This app version can't authorize locally yet. Update the app. Tofi won't switch to the shared computer on its own.
route.http_blocked: A plain HTTP connection can't receive the redirect safely, and no shared computer is set up. Use HTTPS or the Tofi app.
route.loopback_paste: This service accepts only a 127.0.0.1 redirect. Sign in in your browser, then paste the address it redirects to back here.
route.public_origin_missing: Set TOFI_PUBLIC_ORIGIN (the public HTTPS address) on the server, then try again.
route.vm: You're connected over plain HTTP, so only this entry point authorizes on the shared computer. The service must support a local redirect. HTTPS or the Tofi app is recommended.
route.web: Sign in with this device's browser; the provider returns to Tofi's HTTPS server. The shared computer isn't used.

document_delivery.description: Create documents, spreadsheets and slides, check them, then send to chat.
document_delivery.title: Document delivery

research.description: Check sources and turn research into a deliverable file.
research.title: Research

web_review.description: Use the page for real and record issues with repro steps.
web_review.title: Web review

skills.empty: No Skills in the library yet

error.missing_content: Enter a name and the SKILL.md text, or add a folder.
error.name_taken: That name is already taken. Choose another.
error.no_skill_md: The folder needs SKILL.md at its root, or .claude-plugin/plugin.json for a bundle.
error.too_large: A Skill or bundle can be at most 1 MB
error.no_plugin_manifest: A bundle folder needs .claude-plugin/plugin.json at its root.

skills.folder_label: Choose a Skill or bundle folder

library.added_notice: Added to the library. It is off for every Bot until you turn it on in that Bot’s settings.
library.added_all: Added to the library and turned on for every Bot.
library.added_some_one: Added to the library and turned on for {{count}} Bot.
library.added_some_other: Added to the library and turned on for {{count}} Bots.
library.empty_hint: Add a Skill to teach your Bots a repeatable way of working.
library.intro: One library for the whole workspace. A new Skill is turned on for the Bots you choose; change it any time in each Bot’s settings.
library.official_note: Official · on for every Bot unless turned off in its settings
library.remove_bundle_confirm: Remove this bundle and all its Skills?
library.rolled_back: Version changed. Every Bot that has the Skill follows it.

skills.name: Name
skills.remove_confirm: Remove this Skill for every Bot?
skills.support_note: Instructions and reference files are supported. Bundled scripts never run automatically.

vm.cancel_failed: Couldn't cancel. Try again. Authorization ends on its own when it times out.

end.denied: Authorization was canceled. You can connect again.

vm.footer: You'll return automatically when done. Other Bots' screen actions are queued.
vm.subtitle: Finish authorizing on the shared computer

tools.empty: No tools listed yet. Connect and refresh to load them.
tools.explain: Runs without asking: tools the service marks read only, or you mark. Asks when unsure: each call is reviewed, so what you asked for runs and the rest asks you first. Always asks me: you decide every call.
tools.title: Tools · {{count}}
tools.raise_note: Changing to “Always asks me” ends its allowances.
tools.unavailable: Tools are unavailable until Google is connected.

connections.title: Connections

gog.name: Gmail (personal account)
gog.description: Read your own Gmail through a Google account you authorize.

details.community_review: Community code: its tools ask for approval until you mark them read-only.

connections.preview_note: Needs a Google Cloud project enrolled in the Workspace Developer Preview Program, which requires a company or enterprise account. Until then, tool calls can fail with a permission error.

error.api_disabled: The {{name}} API isn’t enabled in your Google Cloud project. Enable it, then refresh.

google.using_client: Using your saved Google client (project {{project}}). No upload needed.
google.tile_description: Gmail, Calendar and Drive for your own Google account.

connecting.lead: Adding {{name}} and opening its sign-in page…

capabilities.community_note: Community code: writes ask every time, and its own read-only marks are ignored. Mark a tool read only below to let it run without asking.

detail.paused_note: Paused. Bots can't use this connection. Its sign-in, tool settings and allowances are kept.

bots.title: Bots
bots.choose: Choose which Bots can use this connection
bots.none: No Bot can use this connection.
bots.new_note: A Bot added later can use it until you limit it on that Bot's page.
